propositions: rebar cannot reconcile against self-hosted Jira Data Center, which differs from Cloud on REST v2 wiki-markup bodies, PAT bearer auth, and name-based user identity.
DC support should be an explicit jira_family shared sub-seam parameterized by RichTextCodec and UserIdentityModel contracts, not a forked second adapter reaching into adapters/jira privates.
The local-to-Jira status and priority maps are already duplicated and drifted across three copies, and the epic consolidates them to a single definition in jira_family adopting deleted->Done.
Location-pinned modules adf.py, outbound_fields.py, and comment_limits.py must not change path and must be shared by dependency inversion rather than relocation to avoid breaking the dynamic loader.

The DC backend must require https for reconciler.base_url, reject non-TLS URLs unless allow_insecure is set with a warning, and never disable certificate verification, reading its PAT only from the JIRA_PAT env var.
classify_probe_response hardcodes Cloud resolved-status names and must accept the resolved-status set as a parameter via reconciler.resolved_statuses so DC workflows are not misclassified.
